caseName: Harper v. Virginia Board of Elections
caseNameFull: Harper v. Virginia Board of Elections
attorneys: Solicitor General Marshall on the motion.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. E. D. Va. (Probable jurisdiction noted, 380 U. S. 930.) Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument, as amicus curiae, granted and thirty minutes are allotted for that purpose. Counsel for appellees are allotted an additional thirty minutes for oral argument.
